text:
alex: Quick heads-up, cutting a tiny hotpatch to 1.11.2 in ~45m. Problem: range-check bug in tokenizer that hits long prompts intermittently. Minimal diffs only, backport to release/1.11 required.

maria: Copy. Which PR is the backport? can we land without migration changes? :eyes:

alex: PR #4578 is the cherry-pick of the fix (tokenizer bounds check). No migrations. Patch is just 6 LOC in tokenizer.c and one unit test.

devon: I can review now. running tests locally. ping me once CI is green, I'll do the canary deploy.

alex: thx. cut list: merge #4578 -> release/1.11, bump package + tag, changelog entry (1 line), create canary job. keep rollout to 5% for 30m.

sophie: changelog nudge: please add short note under "1.11.2 (hotfix)". i'll squash wording if needed.

alex: suggested changelog line: "Fix: tokenizer bounds check that could truncate long prompts (hotfix)." Short and deterministic.

devon: CI shows unit+integration green except flaky rerank test, not related. canary deploy queued.

release-bot: Deploy job started: canary-release/1.11.2 -> 5% traffic. build: 1.11.2-20260317-4578. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/3312 :shipit:

ryan: quick QA note: will run our long-prompt regression suite against canary. ETA ~25m. If regressions, we abort and rollback.

maria: tagging detail: use semver patch bump. run: `git checkout release/1.11 && git merge --no-ff 4578 && npm version patch -m "chore(release): %s"` then push tag.

alex: adding rollback plan here in case: revert tag + force deploy previous build ID (1.11.1-20260310-4450). rollback steps in runbook.

devon: canary is healthy at 5% after 10m. no increased 5xx, latency stable.

sophie: I pushed changelog entry and updated release notes draft. PR #4580.

ryan: long-prompt suite done: no regressions. samples look good.

alex: thanks everyone. if no objections, full rollout in 30m. leaving flags to autoscale disabled. :thumbsup:

maria: ack. I'll watch release channel.

devon: will promote after 30m if stable.

release-bot: Canary stable for 30m. Promoting to 100% per policy.

alex: 1.11.2 promoted to 100%. logging post-deploy checks. Please file any anomalies here.

sophie: added postmortem note slot in release doc in case we see anything.

ryan: closing QA loop, all green. nice work. :tada:
